prompt.zh-TW: 星河軟體的股價是 {{money:vars.price}}。去年實際的每股盈餘是 {{money:vars.epsTrailing}}，公司對今年的預估是 {{money:vars.epsForward}}。佩珊算出兩個本益比：用歷史盈餘是 {{number:vars.peTrailing|unit=times}}，用預估盈餘是 {{number:vars.peForward|unit=times}}。哪一句說法最恰當？
prompt.en: Starriver Software trades at {{money:vars.price}}. Last year’s actual earnings per share were {{money:vars.epsTrailing}}, and the company forecasts {{money:vars.epsForward}} for this year. Pei-shan gets two P/E ratios: {{number:vars.peTrailing|unit=times}} on trailing earnings and {{number:vars.peForward|unit=times}} on forecast earnings. Which statement is the most appropriate?

text.zh-TW: 兩個都算得對，但分母一個是實際盈餘、一個是預估；引用時要標明用哪一個
text.en: Both are right, but one denominator is actual earnings and the other a forecast; whichever is quoted must be labelled

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。歷史本益比與預估本益比各有用途，混著比較會得出錯誤結論；標示清楚是基本功。
feedback.en: That is right. Trailing and forward P/E ratios each have their uses; mixing them leads to wrong conclusions, and labelling them is basic discipline.

text.zh-TW: 預估本益比比較低，所以這家公司其實很便宜，兩個數字可以互換使用
text.en: The forward P/E ratio is lower, so the company is actually cheap, and the two figures are interchangeable

feedback.zh-TW: 你發現預估盈餘會讓倍數變低，觀察正確。但預估可能落空，倍數低是建立在「今年真的賺到兩倍」的假設上；兩個數字不能互換。
feedback.en: You noticed that forecast earnings lower the multiple, a correct observation. But forecasts can miss; the lower multiple rests on the assumption that earnings really double this year. The two figures are not interchangeable.

text.zh-TW: 只有用歷史盈餘算的本益比才是對的，預估數字根本不能拿來算本益比
text.en: Only the P/E ratio on trailing earnings is valid; forecast figures should never be used to calculate it

feedback.zh-TW: 你對預估數字保持懷疑，這個態度很好。不過實務上預估本益比很常用，問題不在能不能用，而在要標示清楚並知道它的不確定性。
feedback.en: Being sceptical of forecasts is a good instinct. In practice, though, forward P/E ratios are widely used; the issue is not whether they may be used but that they must be labelled and their uncertainty understood.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_w1f6}}點出關鍵：分母是歷史還是預估，倍數的意義完全不同。{{option:o_x2g7}}把兩者互換，{{option:o_y3h8}}則走到另一個極端。
explanation.en: {{option:o_w1f6}} makes the key point: whether the denominator is trailing or forecast changes what the multiple means. {{option:o_x2g7}} treats them as interchangeable, and {{option:o_y3h8}} goes to the opposite extreme.
